title: Fantasy Football Loser Flag — Last Place Punishment, Funny Gag
description:
Product overview
- Printed phrase (exact, not altered):
  Eyebrow: LAST PLACE CERTIFIED
  Lines: I SUCK AT | FANTASY | FOOTBALL
  Footer: ASK ANYONE IN MY LEAGUE
- Treatment: loud, direct punishment flag in a dark green sports scoreboard style (bold sans-serif, faux score-grid background, high-contrast white lettering).

Verified product facts
- Double-sided (same print on both sides).
- Suitable for indoor or outdoor display.
- Printed to order.
- Flagpole and mounting hardware are NOT included.

Why this flag
This is a bold, good-natured last-place punishment prop for adult fantasy-football leagues. Designed so the league loser can’t hide at draft parties, watch parties, the office, or an end-of-season event — or for teammates to present as a gag gift. The eyebrow (LAST PLACE CERTIFIED) and footer (ASK ANYONE IN MY LEAGUE) frame the printed lines I SUCK AT / FANTASY / FOOTBALL to read like a mock-official scoreboard confession.

Ordering & production
- This item is printed to order by our production partner: AstraPrint Studio.
- Listing layout and product copy were AI-assisted; final proofing and production are handled by our human team and AstraPrint Studio.

Care & display notes
- For best longevity outdoors, display under partial cover when possible and remove during extreme weather. The flag is printed on weather-rated fabric but is sold without a pole or mounting hardware. Use any standard flagpole or mounting kit you already own.

Buyer reminders
- This flag is intended as an embarrassing-yet-good-natured league punishment prop for consenting adults. Avoid placing it where it would violate venue rules or local sign ordinances.

Search & gift occasions
Perfect for draft day, end-of-season punishment reveals, toilet-bowl losers, league parties, and gag gifts. Priority search terms included: fantasy football loser, last place punishment, funny loser flag.
rationale: Design choice: Scoreboard style in dark green gives a sports-house, mock-official vibe without using league names or real emblems. Bold, high-contrast lettering makes the three printed phrase lines (I SUCK AT / FANTASY / FOOTBALL) readable from across a room; eyebrow (LAST PLACE CERTIFIED) and footer (ASK ANYONE IN MY LEAGUE) add the self-aware confession and league-wide proof elements requested.
